senses.gloss: ल The twenty-eighth consonant of the Nāgari alphabet, the letter L.

ल m. (-लः)
 1. INDRA.
 2. Cutting.
 3. A short syllable, (in prosody.)
4. PĀṆINI'S technical term for all the tenses and modes, (in gram.)
f. (-ला)
 1. Giving.
 2. Receiving, taking.
 f. (-ली)
 1. Embracing,
adhering or clinging to.
 2. Liquifying, melting.
 E. ला to give or
take, &c., aff. क or ड, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष् ।

ला r. 2nd cl. (लाति)
 1. To give.
 2. To get, to receive.
